evidence_policy: Replacement with compiler receipts requires exact head/tree, admitted-axiom check and correct declaration kinds; this contract file creates no theorem authority.

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource
bindings.acceptance: Construct the exact infinite-convolution source; density, support, positivity, symmetry, smoothness, transform and scaling.

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource_nonneg
bindings.acceptance: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → ∀ (x : ℝ), 0 ≤ Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource s x

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource_integral_one
bindings.acceptance: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → ∫ (x : ℝ), Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource s x = 1

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource_support
bindings.acceptance: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → tsupport (Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource s) ⊆ Set.Icc (-s) s

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource_contDiff
bindings.acceptance: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → ContDiff ℝ (↑⊤) (Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource s)

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.paperFT_universalSincSource
bindings.acceptance: ∀ {s : ℝ}, 0 < s → (Zeta23.paperFT fun x => ↑(Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource s x)) = Zeta23.CCM.UniversalSinc.product s

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincSource_gevrey_bound
bindings.acceptance: s>0 implies constructed source-only C,H>0 and for every n,x, |q_s^(n)(x)| <= C H^n (n!)^2. Preserve exact q_s identification.

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.poleKilled_universalSincSource_norm_sq
bindings.acceptance: s>0 implies ||Pq_s||_2^2 = s^-5||q_1 second derivative||_2^2 +(1/2)s^-3||q_1 first derivative||_2^2 +(1/16)s^-1||q_1||_2^2. R2.

bindings.name: Zeta23.CCM.universalSincProduct_decay
bindings.acceptance: Reexport exact all-real-frequency product Gevrey decay, with original constants and domain; no new simplicity assertion.

bindings.name: Zeta23.ExceptionalZero.universalSincPoleKilled_visible_at_offLine_zero
bindings.acceptance: Actual rho with Re rho !=1/2 gives nonzero physical pole-killed transform at the exact paperFT spectral coordinate. Reuse physical identification, not multiplier name only.

bindings.name: Zeta23.ExceptionalZero.originalDetectorCorrelation_neg_excursions
bindings.acceptance: ∀ (ρ : ↑Zeta23.zetaZeroConfig.carrier),   (↑ρ).re ≠ 1 / 2 →     ∀ {β : ℝ},       β < |(↑ρ).re - 1 / 2| →         ∀ (A M : ℝ),           ∃ a, A < a ∧ Zeta23.ExceptionalZero.fixedOriginalSincCorrelationReal a < -(M * Real.exp (2 * β * a))
